# Shared project footer

Source and API: https://github.com/cristonj/project-footer
Release: https://github.com/cristonj/project-footer/releases/tag/v0.2.1

This site consumes the pinned `cristonj-project-footer-0.2.1.tgz` release beside this file. Future projects can be registered through `extraProjects` with their original SVG component; site-specific navigation and colors remain in this app.

To update, download a release tarball, place it here, run `npm install ./vendor/cristonj-project-footer-VERSION.tgz`, and commit the artifact and lockfile. Do not edit node_modules or copy the component source into this app.
